summary: American Savings Bank, National Association operates as a national banking association that provides various financial products and services to individual and business customers in Hawaii. The company offers deposit products such as, checking, savings, money market, and certificates of deposit; lending products, including residential mortgages, home equity lines of credit (HELOC) and consumer loans; interchange products such as, debit and credit card, and investment advisory and insurance. It also provides small business customers with business deposit products, including merchant services, cash management, financial advisory and deposit accounts; and lending products such as, lines of credit and secured and unsecured loans to support businesses. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii. American Savings Bank, National Association was formerly a subsidiary of ASB Hawaii, Inc.
